issue.title: Bump Apicurio registry mem to to 2.4.2.Final as 2.2.5 is not supported

repository.name: quarkus-test-framework
repository.description: Write your test once and run it everywhere!

issue.body:
### Summary

After https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/commit/3414e59da7d4340b98c0d85aa07637cefe88e520 Apicurio registry client is no longer compatible with 2.2.5.Final. Docs is partially mentioning this https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/blob/main/docs/src/main/asciidoc/kafka-schema-registry-avro.adoc#using-compatible-versions-of-the-apicurio-registry, it should be updated with compatibility version soon. 

upstream issue: https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/issues/32643
